description:
In Sunset City, sunny weather now transitions into overcast skies, and after rain, fog settles over the city. Combined with the changing time of day, this makes the city feel even more alive and realistic, while gameplay becomes more immersive and varied.

Different weather conditions are also accompanied by visual changes: raindrops can be seen on the car’s body, and puddles remain on the roads, reflecting the city’s neon glow.

CarX Street has changed, experience it for yourself.

Welcome to the city, where the impact of the everyday actions of a simple public transit driver can have a massive impact. Master 17 buses both licensed and original, from large to small. Become an everyday hero of public transit either in solo or with up to 3 other friends as you safely drive your passengers across 7 unique districts with authentic traffic and random obstacles. The city is waiting: Bus Bound is available now on Xbox Series X|S today.
